units.source_text: 女人的脚背和脚底的交界处，显眼地有难看的细印子。

en.t: At the boundary between the top and sole of the woman's foot, there were conspicuous ugly fine marks.

units.source_text: 他觉得莫名其妙的笑又涌了上来。

en.t: He felt that inexplicable laughter welling up inside him again.

units.source_text: 女人的脚为什么这么奇怪呢？

en.t: Why were the woman's feet so strange?
